name: Climax Ace Warm Gold Silhouette Glow
purpose: Celebrate round-winning 5K ACE with a warm regal golden aura around the hero during orbit camera.
required_visual_conditions: Hero model centered in 3rd-person circular camera path.
required_masks_or_mattes: Elliptical feathered mask tracking hero torso.
recommended_color_palette: Pure gold (#ffd700), warm amber (#d97706), champagne highlights (#fffbeb).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> BrightnessContrast1 -> Glow1 (Glow: 0.85, Color: Gold) -> DirectionalBlur1 (subtle ray sweep) -> Merge1 (Screen) -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion/Color Page: Power window on hero in Color page, raise Gain to 1.15, warm tint to 25° hue; layer with Fusion soft golden bloom.
qa_procedure: Verify hero silhouette remains legible; avoid clipping highlight details on helmet or weapon.
